select detail.equipment_code as equipmentCode, item.item_name as itemName, item.equipment_name as equipmentName, coalesce(detail.spec_model, sku.spec_model, item.model_text) as specModel, detail.product_mark as productMark, detail.quality_grade as qualityGrade, coalesce(detail.unit_price, sku.default_unit_price, 0) as unitPrice, sum(detail.remain_quantity) as quantity, item.unit as unit, sum(detail.remain_quantity * coalesce(detail.unit_price, sku.default_unit_price, 0)) as lineAmount, detail.belong_unit as belongUnit from wms_inventory_detail detail left join wms_item_sku sku on detail.sku_id = sku.id left join wms_item item on sku.item_id = item.id
detail.remain_quantity > 0
and detail.equipment_code like concat('%', #{bo.equipmentCode}, '%')
and item.item_name like concat('%', #{bo.itemName}, '%')
and coalesce(detail.spec_model, sku.spec_model, item.model_text) like concat('%', #{bo.specModel}, '%')
and detail.product_mark like concat('%', #{bo.productMark}, '%')
and item.equipment_name like concat('%', #{bo.equipmentName}, '%')
and detail.quality_grade = #{bo.qualityGrade}
and detail.belong_unit like concat('%', #{bo.belongUnit}, '%')
and coalesce(detail.unit_price, sku.default_unit_price, 0) = #{bo.unitPrice}
and detail.create_time between #{bo.createStartTime} and #{bo.createEndTime}
group by detail.equipment_code, item.item_name, item.equipment_name, coalesce(detail.spec_model, sku.spec_model, item.model_text), detail.product_mark, detail.quality_grade, coalesce(detail.unit_price, sku.default_unit_price, 0), item.unit, detail.belong_unit
